items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: I don't know who was Frank Skinner. Archie Bly and Frank Skinner. Yeah. That's the two... But I don't know who... Yeah. I don't know who they was off the top of it.

ctx.x: I wonder who did and who Rang did then. I can't remember.

I think most of them was Frank Skinner. I don't know who did, I don't think it was Frank Skinner. No. We had quite a few Frank Skinners there. I don't know who was Frank Skinner. I don't know who was Frank Skinner. Archie Bly and Frank Skinner. Yeah. That's the two... Archie Bly and Frank Skinner. Yeah. But I don't know who... Yeah. I don't know who they was off the top of it. Who they was the Rang for, you know? Uh-huh.
How long did you stay with that?
